item.title: Hamilton accepts sarcastic radio messages did not show him in best light
item.description: Lewis Hamilton has rowed back on sarcastic radio messages he made during Sunday's Dutch Grand Prix, saying he had not presented the "best version" of himself.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Lewis Hamilton has rowed back on sarcastic radio messages he made during Sunday's Dutch Grand Prix, saying he had not presented the "best version" of himself. The seven-times Formula One world champion was frustrated at being held up behind Ferrari teammate Charles Leclerc in the race at Zandvoort and felt he [USN:L6N44K06K TEXT:"missed out on a podium"] because of the team's delay in acting. "Big waste of time guys, good job,” he said sarcastically after Leclerc eventually pitted. Looking back on the weekend, Hamilton praised the team in an Instagram post for their work at the factory in bringing updates and improving the car. "I've listened back to some of my radio and TV comments," said the Briton. "In the heat of the moment frustration can come out, especially when you care as deeply as I do. But that wasn't the best version of me. I take responsibility for that, and I'll be better." Hamilton, who finished fourth in the race and less than a second behind Mercedes' George Russell, said he believed in the team and what Ferrari was building for the future. "The direction is clear. The belief is there. And the fight is absolutely still on," he said. Hamilton and Russell are tied on points, with the Mercedes driver ahead on race wins in second place overall and 59 behind his teammate Kimi Antonelli. The next race is in Italy at Monza, a home round for both Ferrari and Antonelli.

item.title: Sterling hovers near six-month high underpinned by BoE rate hike expectations
item.description: The pound held its ground near a six-month high versus the dollar on Tuesday, underpinned by expectations for interest rate hikes by the Bank of England this year, against the backdrop of concerns around sticky inflation and soaring government debt.
item.dc:creator: Johann Cherian
item.content:encoded: The pound held its ground near a six-month high versus the dollar on Tuesday, underpinned by expectations for interest rate hikes by the Bank of England this year, against the backdrop of concerns around sticky inflation and soaring government debt. Sterling was last at $1.3632, while the euro last bought 85.54 pence. The pound has had a strong run over the past four weeks on expectations that better-than-expected economic data through the first half of the year could prompt the Bank of England to raise interest rates by at least 25 basis points this year, LSEG-compiled data showed. However, most analysts and economists see no change in interest rates, raising the risk of a decline in the currency towards the end of the year. Francesco Pesole, an FX strategist at ING said, because they thought the BoE would tighten less than current market expectations, they anticipated the euro to gain on the pound. "We still expect no hikes and a move to £0.870 in the coming months," he said. A drop to 87 pence could mean an at least 2% drop from Tuesday's trading levels. Global currency markets were broadly steady as markets absorbed the latest set of [USN:L1N44L0FC TEXT:"U.S. sanctions"] on Iran, which excluded China or any of the country's entities that if targeted, investors feared, could potentially spark a retaliation from Beijing. Soaring government debt has also been in focus this month after the U.S. Treasury announced plans to increase its buybacks of longer-dated government bonds to cushion the surge in yields. UK Gilt yields are among the highest among developed economies and the next test for maturities and the pound will be the Andy Burnham government's budget, expected in October. On Tuesday, Britain set out [USN:L8N44M07R TEXT:"plans to spend"] £10 billion ($13.6 billion) on lower-cost housing for renters with a focus on London. Investors will be watching to see if the government plans to fund its fiscal policies through more borrowing or tax hikes, as Burnham has also previously announced policies aimed at reducing costs for households.

item.title: Dick's Sporting Goods cuts annual forecasts as athleticwear demand weakens
item.description: Dick's Sporting Goods cut its full-year sales and profit forecasts on Tuesday, as pressured discretionary spending amid a cautious consumer environment weighed on demand for sporting goods and athletic apparel, sending its shares down 13% in premarket trading.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Dick's Sporting Goods (DKS.N) cut its full-year sales and profit forecasts on Tuesday, as pressured discretionary spending amid a cautious consumer environment weighed on demand for sporting goods and athletic apparel, sending its shares down 13% in premarket trading. The company now expects annual sales of $21.9 billion to 22.2 billion, compared with its earlier forecast of $22.1 billion to $22.4 billion. "Not only were there fewer launches in the second quarter, but those launches performed below both industry and our expectations," said Ed Stack, the company's executive chairman. "As a result, we are taking a more cautious view of the balance of the year," Stack added. Consumers remain selective with discretionary spending amid inflationary pressures and economic uncertainty, posing risks to demand for sporting goods and athletic apparel. A slowdown in consumer spending and a weakening job market have been weighing on demand for higher-priced athletic gear and outdoor equipment. The company now expects annual earnings per share of $10.94 to $11.94, compared with its earlier forecast of $13.27 to $14.27.

item.title: US ‘D-Day’ on Iran barely makes it off the beach
item.description: Washington says it will expand secondary sanctions while blacklisting nearly 60 entities aiding Tehran. To match its own hype, it needed to risk blowback by targeting a major Chinese or UAE bank. As it is, the US financial assault on Iran may fare no better than its military one.
item.dc:creator: Afiq Fitri Alias
item.content:encoded: The original D-Day marked a series of successful Allied landings on French shores that heralded the end of World War 2. U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent's so-called “Economic D-Day”, in contrast, barely makes it off the beach. In a much-anticipated press conference on August 24, Washington launched what it called Operation Economic Outcast, blacklisting nearly 60 entities linked to Iran, while expanding the activities that could expose foreign firms to future sanctions. It hardly aligns with all the hype. The sanctions sabre-rattling is not nothing. Bessent’s package ranges from shadow-fleet operators and shipping companies to procurement networks supporting Iran’s missile and nuclear programmes. The Treasury also broadened sanctions risk across sectors including shipping, aviation, technology, gold and digital assets, bluntly asserting that entities transacting with Iran would lose access to the U.S. financial system. Yet given the build-up, investors would have expected something bigger and unprecedented. If Bessent and U.S. President Donald Trump had wanted to match their own rhetoric, according to Tom Keatinge, director of the Centre for Finance and Security at the Royal United Services Institute, they could have targeted a major Chinese or UAE financial institution helping the Iranian regime move money around the world. After all China accounts for 90% of Iranian oil exports, which generated $43 billion for Tehran in 2024. A report last year by the U.S. Treasury itself, meanwhile, detected $8.6 billion in Iran-linked flows in 2024 across the UAE and other financial hubs in Asia. Such a move may still be in the offing: Bessent said he expected a “major financial institution” to be sanctioned by the end of the week. Yet it’s no great surprise it remains theoretical. While action might force Beijing or Abu Dhabi to choose between accommodating Tehran and preserving access to the dollar system, it would also risk retaliatory Chinese measures on rare earth exports and substantially cool relations with a key Gulf ally. The UAE, one of Iran's most important commercial gateways, has already signalled a willingness to curb trade and financial ties. Yet that may not materially hobble Tehran. As Iran hawks at the Foundation for Defense of Democracies think tank point out , robust action would mean forcing UAE banks to identify the beneficial owners of shell companies that obscure their links to the regime. Given this might cut across [USN:L6N40S0N7 TEXT:"Dubai’s role as a financial hub"], it is not something Abu Dhabi would agree to lightly. Washington already has an effective weapon against Iran’s oil revenues: its reimposed military blockade. [USN:L4N44E0KL TEXT:"According to ship-tracking company Kpler"], there have been no visible crossings of the Strait of Hormuz by supertankers carrying Iranian crude since mid-July. If the main financial damage has already been inflicted by other means and Bessent continues to pull his punches, it raises the question of what the “Economic D-Day” is actually for. U.S. President Donald Trump's administration on Monday warned countries to cut their business ties with Iran or face secondary sanctions as part of what it billed as an "economic D-Day”. In a press conference announcing the move, U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent declined to say what specific countries would be targeted, or when those penalties would take effect. The Treasury Department also announced new sanctions on 60 individuals, entities and vessels. "Why would I want to blow up the global financial system? We believe that it is important to level set and give people a cure period, but they should know that that will move very quickly and that we are serious," Bessent said. He added that he expected a major financial institution to be sanctioned by the end of the week. Bessent also singled out Iran's Bank Melli, which continues to operate branches in Europe, the Middle East and Asia. "Every branch of Bank Melli must be shuttered and dark," he said. CONTEXT-NEWS

item.title: Prosus is struggling to shed Tencent shadow
item.description: The €82 bln investor’s future is in focus after it lost out on Delivery Hero to Uber. CEO Fabricio Bloisi is placing bigger bets on food delivery and payments. Yet Tencent still makes up three quarters of its value, leaving its shares hostage to the Chinese tech giant's fortunes.
item.dc:creator: Jennifer Johnson
item.content:encoded: Prosus (PRX.AS) is among Europe’s largest technology companies – but that has never been a major selling point for investors. As Tencent’s (0700.HK) largest shareholder, its shares move in lockstep with those of the Chinese e-commerce titan. CEO Fabricio Bloisi is betting that Prosus’ payments and food-delivery ventures will lift its valuation and persuade shareholders to see it as more than a Tencent wrapper. His strategy is starting to pay off in Latin America, though Europe will be the real litmus test. The relationship with Tencent began 25 years ago when Prosus' parent company, Naspers, made an early investment in the then-fledgling Chinese internet group. It went on to create WeChat, a so-called “super app” in which users can do everything from messaging to shopping and travel bookings. When Naspers created and listed Prosus in 2019, it bundled the Tencent holding into the new entity. The move has proved to be both a blessing and a curse. The $115 billion Tencent stake accounts for three-quarters of Prosus’ total $155 billion investment portfolio, based on the Dutch group’s own calculations . After deducting debt, Prosus’ net asset value is $149 billion, and yet its market capitalisation is only $96 billion, implying a 35% discount. One implication is that investors largely disregard the value of the $33 billion private portfolio, which includes stakes in online classifieds group OLX, Brazilian food-delivery platform iFood and payments provider PayU. On one level, that discount looks excessive. The group’s free cash flow excluding dividends paid by Tencent reached $275 million in the year to March 31 – up from $18 million for the same period in 2025. Latin America was a standout, with iFood's revenue up 40% on a reported basis, while its adjusted EBITDA rose 56% to $400 million. Bloisi is hoping it serves as a template for success elsewhere in the world. The group has been able to use its iFood delivery app to steer customers towards its other available services, including Latin American travel booking app Despegar. Prosus is betting that this so-called “ecosystem” approach is the key to emerging from Tencent’s shadow. However, replicating it won’t be easy in Europe, where Prosus is working to turn around Just Eat Takeaway, its flagship food delivery app in the region. When it bought the business in November 2025, it inherited a platform with dwindling demand, high delivery costs and a messy internal technology setup. Though Prosus has said pilot programmes it's running in select cities have shown order growth of up to 25%, turning Just Eat into an iFood-style juggernaut will take time. The deal also came with a hidden sting. As a condition of buying Just Eat, European antitrust officials demanded that Prosus cut its stake in the profitable and growing Delivery Hero, which opened the door for Uber to swoop in and agree to purchase it in its entirety in [USN:L6N43J0GH TEXT:"July"]. Once the $15 billion acquisition is completed, Uber will control the largest food-delivery group outside of China. That’s a strong competitive position, which leaves Prosus looking like a relative underdog. Given its “ecosystem” will take time to prove its value, for now its fortunes will be tethered to Tencent. Follow Jennifer Johnson on Bluesky and LinkedIn . On August 19, Indian fintech startup Navi said it will raise $100 million from Dutch tech investor Prosus. According to a source cited by the Economic Times, the investment values the group at $1.3 billion. Prosus also owns around 25% of Swiggy, an Indian food-delivery and quick-commerce platform, and a minority stake in Bengaluru-based ride hailing platform Rapido. In July, the Amsterdam-based group agreed to sell its remaining 16.8% stake in Delivery Hero to Uber following the ride-hailing group’s recent takeover offer for the firm. CONTEXT-NEWS

item.title: Carlos Ezpeleta promoted to deputy CEO of MotoGP Group
item.description: Carlos Ezpeleta has been promoted to deputy CEO of MotoGP Group, the commercial rights holder of the motorcycle racing championships, the organisation said on Tuesday, bringing him into the company's top leadership team alongside his father, CEO Carmelo Ezpeleta.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Carlos Ezpeleta has been promoted to deputy CEO of MotoGP Group, the commercial rights holder of the motorcycle racing championships, the organisation said on Tuesday, bringing him into the company's top leadership team alongside his father, CEO Carmelo Ezpeleta. Ezpeleta, who joined the Madrid-based company as an intern in 2007 and rose through the ranks to become MotoGP's chief sporting officer, takes on the new role as the organisation looks to strengthen its leadership structure ahead of its next phase of growth and transformation. MotoGP Group said Ezpeleta had played a key role in expanding the championship's international footprint, strengthening strategic partnerships and growing its global fanbase. "Carlos has played a fundamental role in the growth of MotoGP over many years," Carmelo said. "His experience spans every part of our business and his leadership, vision and passion for the sport make him the right person to help guide MotoGP into its next chapter," Carmelo added.

item.title: Avião de transporte militar dos EUA pousa em Moscou; Kremlin diz que ainda não tem informações
item.description: Um avião de transporte militar dos EUA pousou no aeroporto de Vnukovo, em Moscou, nesta terça-feira, segundo dados do serviço de rastreamento de voos Flightradar24.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Um avião de transporte militar dos EUA pousou no aeroporto de Vnukovo, em Moscou, nesta terça-feira, segundo dados do serviço de rastreamento de voos Flightradar24. O grande Boeing Globemaster, com o número de cauda registrado nos EUA 07-7181, voou diretamente de Riga, na Letônia, e pousou em Moscou por volta das 4h (horário de Brasília). A Reuters não conseguiu verificar se a aeronave transportava carga ou passageiros. O Kremlin afirmou não ter informações sobre o avião. A aeronave havia chegado a Riga em 23 de agosto vinda da base aérea norte-americana de Camp Springs, perto de Washington, DC, segundo dados do Flightradar24. O último voo direto de um jato registrado nos EUA para a Rússia, partindo da Europa, ocorreu em janeiro deste ano, transportando os enviados especiais Steven Witkoff e Jared Kushner para negociações de paz com Vladimir Putin sobre a Ucrânia. O Kremlin afirmou na semana passada que ainda não havia informações sobre uma nova visita de Kushner e Witkoff a Moscou, já que as negociações entre os EUA e a Rússia sobre a Ucrânia estão praticamente paralisadas em meio à guerra no Irã.

item.title: Un avión de transporte militar estadounidense aterriza en Moscú, el Kremlin no tiene detalles
item.description: Un avión de transporte militar estadounidense aterrizó el martes en el aeropuerto de Vnúkovo, en Moscú, según datos del servicio de seguimiento de vuelos Flightradar24.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Un avión de transporte militar estadounidense aterrizó el martes en el aeropuerto de Vnúkovo, en Moscú, según datos del servicio de seguimiento de vuelos Flightradar24. El gran Boeing Globemaster, con el número de cola 07-7181 registrado en Estados Unidos, había volado directamente desde Riga, en Letonia, y aterrizó en Moscú alrededor de las 0700 GMT. Reuters no pudo verificar si transportaba carga o pasajeros. El Kremlin dijo que no disponía de información sobre el avión. La aeronave había llegado a Riga el 23 de agosto procedente de la base aérea estadounidense de Camp Springs, cerca de Washington D. C., según datos de Flightradar24. El último vuelo directo de un avión matriculado en EEUU a Rusia desde Europa tuvo lugar en enero de este año, y transportaba a los enviados especiales Steven Witkoff y Jared Kushner para mantener conversaciones de paz con Vladímir Putin sobre Ucrania. El Kremlin declaró la semana pasada que aún no había información sobre otra visita a Moscú de Kushner y Witkoff, ya que las conversaciones entre EEUU y Rusia sobre Ucrania se han estancado en gran medida durante la guerra en Irán.

item.title: Defense firm Ursa Major to go public through $2.3 billion SPAC deal
item.description: Aerospace and defense company Ursa Major will go public in the United States through a $2.3 billion deal with blank-check firm Bleichroeder Acquisition Corp. III, the companies said on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Aerospace and defense company Ursa Major will go public in the United States through a $2.3 billion deal with blank-check firm Bleichroeder Acquisition Corp. III, the companies said on Tuesday. The deal comes as defense technology startups and suppliers attract growing investor interest amid heightened geopolitical tensions and increasing demand for cheaper weapons that can be produced quickly, including drones, autonomous systems and the rockets and missiles used to counter them. The deal implies a pre-money equity valuation of about $1.6 billion for Ursa Major and a post-transaction equity valuation of about $2.3 billion. The transaction includes at least $350 million private investment in public equity (PIPE) led by Inflection Point. The proceeds will accelerate the expansion of Ursa Major's production capabilities across solid rocket motors, the HAVOC Missile System and liquid hypersonic engines, the companies said. Founded in 2015, the Berthoud, Colorado-based firm builds rocket engines, hypersonic systems and solid rocket motors for space exploration and national defense. Ursa Major has conducted more than 5,500 ground tests and 140,000 seconds of testing and its engines have powered more than a dozen successful hypersonic missions, according to the companies. Cantor is serving as lead financial advisor to Bleichroeder, while Moelis is exclusive capital markets advisor to Ursa Major.

item.title: USS Abraham Lincoln to dock in Thailand next week, Thai official says
item.description: The U.S. Navy aircraft carrier the USS Abraham Lincoln will dock in Thailand next week, a Thai official said on Tuesday, following a prolonged deployment in the Middle East and reports of mental health concerns and deteriorating conditions aboard.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The U.S. Navy aircraft carrier the USS Abraham Lincoln will dock in Thailand next week, a Thai official said on Tuesday, following a prolonged deployment in the Middle East and reports of mental health concerns and deteriorating conditions aboard. The Lincoln, which left the Middle East on Saturday, has not made a port call in more than 200 days, setting a [USN:L6N44D05S TEXT:"modern-day record"] for consecutive days at sea, according to Democratic lawmakers. Typically naval deployments are for between six and nine months, but during times of conflict, that can be extended. The ship, which has roughly 5,000 sailors and Marines aboard, will be in Thailand for "rest and recreation after their long sea journey," the official said, asking not to be named. Spokespersons for the Thai Navy and the U.S. Embassy in Bangkok did not immediately respond to a request for comment. The Lincoln left its home port of San Diego in November and was later redirected to the Middle East to support U.S. military operations in the war with Iran. Two military-focused outlets, Navy Times and Stars and Stripes, this month reported suicide attempts and declining morale on the ship. U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth has said the reports "[USN:S0N43A054 TEXT:"completely misrepresented"]" the conditions on board. Thailand is the United States' only treaty partner in mainland Southeast Asia, having been a treaty ally since 1954 and a major non-NATO ally since 2003. Both countries' militaries maintain strong relations.

item.title: United Airlines expects enough Airbus A321XLR deliveries for 2027 Europe expansion
item.description: United Airlines said on Tuesday it expects enough Airbus A321XLR deliveries to support its European expansion next summer, as the carrier pushes into smaller markets and sees travel to the region staying strong into the autumn months.
item.dc:creator: Rajesh Singh
item.content:encoded: United Airlines (UAL.O) said on Tuesday it expects enough Airbus (AIR.PA) A321XLR deliveries to support its European expansion next summer, as the carrier pushes into smaller markets and sees travel to the region staying strong into the autumn months. The Chicago-based airline plans to use the long-range, single-aisle jet on five new European routes in 2027, including Luxembourg, Ibiza, Spain, and Toulouse, France. They are part of the largest international expansion in the airline's history, with service to 10 new cities in Europe and Asia. Patrick Quayle, United's senior vice president of global network planning and alliances, acknowledged "a few teething issues" with the A321XLR program but said the airline expects to have an adequate number delivered to fly the routes. "We feel confident that we will have the number of aircraft needed in order to operate the schedule," he told reporters. Other airlines, including [USN:L1N42B0WP TEXT:"Air Canada"] (AC.TO) , have faced delays in receiving A321XLRs as Airbus has grappled with production and supply-chain constraints. United ordered the A321XLR in 2019 and plans to begin international service with the aircraft on December 1, 2026, from Washington Dulles to Amsterdam and Dublin. The A321XLR will also help United phase out its aging Boeing (BA.N) 757 fleet. Quayle said United is phasing out its 757s as the A321XLR jets enter service, and that the fleet plan is continually updated to account for delays at aircraft manufacturers. Airbus delays, however, have held up the entry into service of United's A321neo Coastliner fleet, planned for premium transcontinental flights. EUROPE TRAVEL DEMAND STRETCHES INTO AUTUMN United's expansion comes as the airline sees more European routes remaining viable later in the year. Quayle said schedules are no longer being cut as sharply after the U.S. Labor Day holiday, with the season extending into October or even November. "The schedule is not being pulled down as quickly in September as it used to be right after Labor Day," he said. Air Canada said this month that revenue for September and October is likely to [USN:L1N44A171 TEXT:"break records"] for those months as more premium travelers avoid the heat and summer crowds in Europe and Japan. United said it had seen no decline in European travel this summer because of [USN:L4N4430GI TEXT:"extreme heat"]. "Demand is incredibly strong," Quayle said.

item.title: Volkswagen workers, Lower Saxony submit alternative turnaround proposals, sources say
item.description: Volkswagen's labour representatives and major shareholder Lower Saxony have drawn up alternative turnaround proposals for the automaker which they plan to introduce at a supervisory board meeting next week, three people familiar with the matter said.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Volkswagen's labour representatives and major shareholder Lower Saxony have drawn up alternative turnaround proposals for the automaker which they plan to introduce at a supervisory board meeting next week, three people familiar with the matter said. The plans rival a proposal put forward by Volkswagen's management - including job cuts and possible plant closures - highlighting just how deep the conflict over the scope of Volkswagen's overhaul runs among its stakeholders. A proposed restructuring sought by CEO Oliver Blume failed to get the necessary support of the supervisory board in July. It is next scheduled to meet on September 4, according to sources familiar with the talks. Spokespeople for Volkswagen's supervisory board, the works council and Lower Saxony, Volkswagen's second-biggest shareholder, declined to comment.

item.title: Bangladesh could consider joining Mecca pact, in test for foreign ties
item.description: Bangladesh could consider joining the Mecca pact, a mutual defence agreement signed this month between Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan, a minister said, a move that could complicate its foreign relations, particularly with neighbouring India.
item.dc:creator: Ruma Paul
item.content:encoded: Bangladesh could consider joining the Mecca pact, a mutual defence [USN:L6N4440I6 TEXT:"agreement"] signed this month between Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan, a minister said, a move that could complicate its foreign relations, particularly with neighbouring India. Ties have been strained as Bangladesh accused Indian border forces of [USN:L4N42C0OL TEXT:"forcibly pushing"] in people while it seeks extradition of former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina, who has lived in exile in India since her ouster in a protest movement in August 2024. "If there is a security arrangement among Islamic nations in the Middle East, it is not unusual for us to consider participating. It is being viewed positively," said junior foreign minister Humayun Kabir. "They are inviting the leadership of Bangladesh, particularly Prime Minister Tarique Rahman, to come and participate," he told reporters on Monday. A source in the Bangladesh foreign ministry told Reuters that Saudi Arabia had invited Dhaka to join the pact, but did not say when the invitation was made. The source sought anonymity as he was not authorised to speak to media. The three Sunni Muslim-majority countries signed the agreement, modelled on NATO's collective-defence principle, in the Saudi holy city of Mecca this month. They pledged that an armed attack on one member would be treated as an attack on all, amid heightened tension in the regional conflagration that has brought Iranian missile fire across the Middle East. Bangladesh, like Turkey, is a secular republic, although more than 90% of its population identifies as Sunni Muslim. Asked for comment on the minister's remarks, the embassies of Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan in the South Asian country did not immediately respond to requests for comment. Turkey, which has NATO's second-largest army, has said the pact with nuclear-armed Pakistan and top oil exporter Saudi Arabia was open to expansion. TEST OF LONG-STANDING FOREIGN POLICY Analysts say joining a military alliance would test Bangladesh's long-standing foreign policy of avoiding rival geopolitical camps to help it attract investment, expand exports and maintain economic ties with competing powers. The economy relies on exports of readymade garments, most of which go to Britain, the European Union and the United States, while remittances from millions of workers abroad, mainly in the Middle East, are a major source of foreign exchange. Formal alliance membership could complicate Bangladesh's ties not just with India, but also China, Iran, Japan, Kuwait, Oman, Qatar, Russia, the United Arab Emirates and the United States, said geopolitical analyst Kollol Kibria. "These relationships would not automatically break, but once Bangladesh joins a military bloc, the question of which side Bangladesh is on becomes much harder to avoid," Kibria said. COMPLICATIONS IN TIES WITH INDIA The invitation comes at a delicate moment in Bangladesh's relations with India under Rahman's six-month-old government, despite efforts by both to ensure cordial ties. The [USN:P8N433075 TEXT:"prime minister"] has yet to decide whether to visit India, Rahman's spokesperson said this month, as Dhaka awaits New Delhi's response to its extradition request for Hasina. Dhaka has previously called for a [USN:L4N44D021 TEXT:""propitious environment""] for such a visit after Hasina spoke to journalists in New Delhi this month, a move criticised by Bangladesh. India's foreign ministry spokesperson on the Mecca pact said it was closely following developments in West Asia. Analysts said New Delhi was unlikely to welcome Bangladesh's membership of a security alliance that includes arch foe Pakistan, although Dhaka would ultimately need to weigh the broader economic and strategic consequences of such a move. The perception of alignment could create risks for Bangladesh's export-driven economy, reliant on stable commercial and diplomatic ties with a wide range of partners, said Asif Shahan, a development studies professor at Dhaka University. "If Bangladesh joins this alliance, several countries, including India, will not be pleased," Shahan added. "However, that should not be the basis of Bangladesh's decision."

item.title: Irã promete resistir à ampliação das sanções dos EUA e diz que Washington busca negociações
item.description: O Irã prometeu reagir à ampliação das sanções dos EUA destinadas a isolar sua economia, expressando confiança de que os principais parceiros comerciais resistirão à campanha de pressão e afirmando que Washington está interessada em retomar as negociações.
item.dc:creator: Yasmine Ghania, David Lawder
item.content:encoded: O Irã prometeu reagir à ampliação das sanções dos EUA destinadas a isolar sua economia, expressando confiança de que os principais parceiros comerciais resistirão à campanha de pressão e afirmando que Washington está interessada em retomar as negociações. Quase seis meses após o início de um conflito que os EUA têm dificuldade em resolver, o secretário do Tesouro, Scott Bessent, divulgou as medidas na segunda-feira, mas evitou impor as sanções mais severas. Embora tenha afirmado que os países que continuassem a negociar com o Irã corriam o risco de serem excluídos do sistema financeiro baseado no dólar, ele se recusou a fornecer um prazo ou identificar quais países poderiam ser alvo das medidas, dizendo que lhes daria tempo para cumprir a nova diretiva. Abbas Golroo, chefe da Comissão de Relações Exteriores do Parlamento iraniano, disse que o chefe do Exército do Paquistão, Asim Munir, entregou uma mensagem dos EUA ao Irã na segunda-feira. "Ao que parece, o objetivo principal era retomar o processo político paralisado", declarou ele à agência de notícias Isna. Não houve comentário imediato da Casa Branca ou do Departamento de Estado. O Departamento do Tesouro anunciou novas sanções contra 60 pessoas físicas, entidades e embarcações, mas a lista não incluía nenhuma das instituições financeiras chinesas suspeitas de facilitar o comércio de petróleo do Irã. “Queremos deixar claro aqui hoje que ninguém está acima do alcance das sanções dos EUA”, declarou Bessent em resposta a uma pergunta sobre bancos chineses. A China tem sido a maior compradora de petróleo iraniano há vários anos, embora o bloqueio dos portos iranianos pelos EUA tenha reduzido o fluxo de petróleo iraniano para a China desde que Washington o renovou em meados de julho. Especialistas afirmam que Washington teme uma retaliação chinesa por quaisquer sanções contra seus bancos antes das negociações previstas para o próximo mês entre o presidente Donald Trump e o presidente chinês Xi Jinping, sendo que quaisquer restrições sobre exportações chinesas de minerais essenciais são especialmente delicadas. A China afirmou nesta terça-feira que sua cooperação com o Irã é conduzida dentro da estrutura do direito internacional e não deve ser interferida nem interrompida. Os preços do petróleo caíram pelo segundo dia consecutivo, à medida que os operadores ignoraram o impacto das sanções, embora os participantes do mercado continuassem cautelosos quanto à capacidade contínua do Irã de interromper o transporte marítimo. PETROLEIRO ATINGIDO PERTO DO ESTREITO DE ORMUZ Um petroleiro foi atingido na terça-feira por um projétil não identificado e ficou inoperante a cerca de 17 km a nordeste de Ash Shishah, em Omã, local que fica na entrada do Estreito de Ormuz, informou a Agência de Operações de Comércio Marítimo do Reino Unido. Antes da notícia das últimas sanções, o Irã ameaçou tanto com uma possível resposta militar quanto com uma redução ainda maior nas exportações de petróleo do Golfo, em retaliação a quaisquer medidas econômicas dos EUA. Irã e Estados Unidos assinaram um acordo provisório em junho com o objetivo de pôr fim à guerra que começou com ataques dos EUA e de Israel ao Irã em fevereiro, mas o acordo rapidamente fracassou e o Irã retomou os ataques, que bloquearam a maior parte das exportações de energia do Golfo. O Paquistão, atuando como mediador, fez "progressos significativos" nas negociações mais recentes com Teerã, as quais se concentraram em evitar uma nova escalada e na reabertura do Estreito de Ormuz, informaram as Forças Armadas paquistanesas. "Tivemos uma troca de ideias muito construtiva", afirmou na rede social X o ministro do Interior do Paquistão, Mohsin Naqvi, que acompanhou Munir a Teerã.

item.title: TSX futures rise as investors assess bank earnings, US tariffs
item.description: Futures tracking Canada's financials-heavy stock index edged higher on Tuesday, as investors weighed positive quarterly bank earnings and trade tensions with the U.S.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Futures tracking Canada's financials-heavy stock index edged higher on Tuesday, as investors weighed positive quarterly bank earnings and trade tensions with the U.S. Futures on the S&P/TSX index rose 0.2% to 2,154.10 points at 6:30 a.m. ET. BMO Financial (BMO.TO) [USN:L4N44M0JP TEXT:"reported"] a rise in third-quarter profit on Tuesday, driven by strong performance in its capital markets business. Bank of Nova Scotia (BNS.TO) also [USN:L4N44M0J3 TEXT:"posted"] a rise in third-quarter profit, helped by higher interest income. The results add to a broader rally in bank stocks, which have outperformed the benchmark index, TSX, this year. The financial sector [USN:L6N43V17D TEXT:"hit"] its highest level in eight years earlier this month. Focus is also on U.S.-Canada trade tensions after President Donald Trump on Monday threatened to [USN:L6N44L0PR TEXT:"raise"] U.S. tariffs on all cars, trucks and automotive parts from Canada to 50% starting January 1, 2027 — escalating a trade fight after negotiations collapsed last week. The deal on the table would have cut the top-line tariff rate on Canadian cars and light-duty trucks to 15% from 25% and the tariffs on aluminum and steel to 25% from 50%. Among commodities, oil prices hit a one-week low as investors shrugged off the latest U.S. sanctions threat against Iran. Brent crude futures shed 3%, while West Texas Intermediate crude slipped 2.9%. Gold prices also slipped, with profit-taking and a firmer dollar curbing gains ahead of U.S. inflation data and remarks from Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh this week. Spot gold was down 0.4%, while silver shed 1.5%. item.title: India's sugar mills, refiners seen importing just half of duty-free quota
item.description: Indian sugar mills and refiners are likely to import only about half of the 1 million metric tons of raw sugar the government has allowed duty-free, as falling domestic prices have eroded the profitability of imports, industry officials told Reuters.
item.dc:creator: Rajendra Jadhav
item.content:encoded: Indian sugar mills and refiners are likely to import only about half of the 1 million metric tons of raw sugar the government has allowed duty-free, as falling domestic prices have eroded the profitability of imports, industry officials told Reuters. The world's biggest sugar consumer last week [USN:L1N44H0KE TEXT:"allowed duty-free imports"] until October 31 to ease record-high prices ahead of the festival season, when demand for traditional sweets typically peaks. But domestic ex-mill prices have fallen nearly 20% from the record high hit last week. "Imports looked attractive last week, when prices were firm and rising. But the sharp price drop since the announcement has taken the shine off imports for millers," said Rahil Shaikh, managing director of Mumbai-based trader MEIR Commodities India. The import margin is thin, and there is no guarantee it will hold when shipments arrive in nearly two months, Shaikh said. Shaikh and four other dealers at global trading houses said imports are unlikely to exceed 500,000 tons, with most of the volume likely to be taken up by refineries. DOMESTIC SUPPLIES EXPECTED TO RISE FROM MID-OCTOBER India has a handful of port-based sugar refineries that import raw sugar duty-free for refining and export the resulting white sugar. The government last week allowed these refiners to apply for the import quota, enabling them to sell refined sugar made from already-imported raw sugar in the domestic market until the end of October. These refineries could quickly sell around 300,000 tons of stocks they are holding in the domestic market, said a Mumbai-based dealer at a global trading house, who declined to be named in line with company policy. But mills are not interested in imports as domestic supplies are expected to rise from mid-October with the start of the new crushing season, potentially putting further pressure on local prices, he said. India has asked mills to bring forward the start of sugarcane crushing to October 15 to boost supplies. New Delhi has allowed imports of only raw sugar, which is likely to be sourced mainly from top producer Brazil and must be processed before being sold in the domestic market. There is a need to allow duty-free imports of white sugar along with raw sugar to quickly boost supplies, said the Mumbai-based dealer.

item.title: More than 120 injured in fire at Russian gas chemical complex, one Chinese worker killed
item.description: At least 19 people were being treated in hospital and more than a hundred more suffered injuries after a fire broke out on Tuesday at a gas chemical complex under construction in Russia's Far East, killing one Chinese national.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: At least 19 people were being treated in hospital and more than a hundred more suffered injuries after a fire [USN:S8N42X02O TEXT:"broke out"] on Tuesday at a gas chemical complex under construction in Russia's Far East, killing one Chinese national. "Despite prompt medical attention, one of the victims — a Chinese national employed by a contractor — could not be saved. His family will receive support, including financial assistance," the facility in the Amur region said in a statement. The complex, which bills itself as one of the world's largest polyethylene and polypropylene producers, is a joint project of Russian company Sibur and Chinese oil and gas company Sinopec. It has yet to start production. Russia frequently employs cheap foreign labour, including from China, for construction of large infrastructure projects. The facility said work was continuing at the site to extinguish the blaze and specialists were carrying out a controlled burn of the remaining industrial gases.

item.title: Bangladesh in talks to buy Chinese J-10CE fighter jets
item.description: Bangladesh is moving closer to formal negotiations with China over a possible purchase of J-10CE fighter jets and attack helicopters, with a government panel preparing a draft agreement, the Prime Minister's Information and Broadcasting Adviser Zahed Ur Rahman said on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Bangladesh is moving closer to formal negotiations with China over a possible purchase of J-10CE fighter jets and attack helicopters, with a government panel preparing a draft agreement, the Prime Minister's Information and Broadcasting Adviser Zahed Ur Rahman said on Tuesday. The planned purchase would be one of Bangladesh's biggest defence procurements in years and would deepen military ties with Beijing, already Dhaka's largest arms supplier. The J-10CE has attracted global attention since Pakistan said it was used to [USN:L1N3RG0WQ TEXT:"down Indian fighters"] during clashes between the nuclear-armed neighbours in May 2025, claims that remain disputed. Rahman said that Dhaka had taken note of the Chinese aircraft's reported strong performance during the conflict in its neighbourhood. Bangladesh is seeking to modernise its air force and is considering the purchase of up to 24 J-10CE aircraft, local media has reported. Pakistan is the only confirmed foreign operator of the export variant of the jet. Rahman did not disclose the number of aircraft Dhaka plans to buy, the value of the deal or a delivery timeline, saying those details would be determined through negotiations. China has supplied Bangladesh with naval vessels, combat aircraft, tanks and missile systems over the past two decades, making it the country's largest source of military hardware.

item.title: Zelenskiy vê janela de oportunidade para mediação dos EUA até o verão europeu de 2027
item.description: A Ucrânia vê uma janela de oportunidade para que a mediação dos Estados Unidos ponha fim à guerra da Rússia na Ucrânia até o final do próximo verão europeu e elaborou um documento de uma página com sugestões, em colaboração com autoridades norte-americanas e europeias, a ser apresentado a Moscou, disse o presidente ucraniano, Volodymyr Zelenskiy.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Ucrânia vê uma janela de oportunidade para que a mediação dos Estados Unidos ponha fim à guerra da Rússia na Ucrânia até o final do próximo verão europeu e elaborou um documento de uma página com sugestões, em colaboração com autoridades norte-americanas e europeias, a ser apresentado a Moscou, disse o presidente ucraniano, Volodymyr Zelenskiy. Zelenskiy disse que um cessar-fogo e uma proposta dos EUA, discutida anteriormente, para uma zona econômica livre na região de Donbas, no leste da Ucrânia — a ser administrada por uma terceira parte — estavam entre as ideias contidas no documento. “Ele contém uma das ideias para um cessar-fogo — esse é o ponto principal. A segunda parte diz respeito ao que os americanos propuseram em relação a uma zona econômica livre”, disse Zelenskiy a repórteres em uma coletiva no fim de semana. Nesta terça-feira, o Kremlin questionou a viabilidade da ideia dos EUA de criar uma zona econômica livre no Donbas, afirmando que o território faz parte formalmente da Rússia e que, portanto, era improvável que uma terceira parte pudesse administrá-lo. A Rússia reivindicou quatro regiões ucranianas como suas, apesar de não controlá-las totalmente. Moscou tem afirmado repetidamente que qualquer solução deve envolver a cessão total das quatro regiões pela Ucrânia, bem como a resolução das “causas profundas” do conflito. Zelenskiy afirmou que vê uma janela de oportunidade para pôr fim aos quase quatro anos e meio de combates, que se estenderia desde a cúpula do G20 nos EUA, em dezembro deste ano, até o final do verão europeu de 2027, tendo em vista a iminente campanha para a eleição presidencial de 2028 nos EUA. Zelenskiy disse no início deste mês que a Ucrânia havia apresentado propostas aos negociadores norte-americanos para um plano de fim da guerra, sem fornecer mais detalhes. As negociações de paz lideradas pelos EUA fracassaram no início deste ano, pois a Ucrânia recusou as exigências russas de ceder mais território e Washington passou a se preocupar cada vez mais com o conflito com o Irã. Os negociadores dos EUA, Steve Witkoff e Jared Kushner, estiveram em Moscou pela última vez em janeiro e ainda não visitaram Kiev. (Reportagem de Anna Pruchnicka, em Gdansk, e Max Hunder, em Kiev)

item.title: EEUU prepara el regreso de diplomáticos a sus embajadas en Oriente Medio, según el NYT
item.description: El Departamento de Estado de EEUU se está preparando para enviar de regreso a sus diplomáticos a las embajadas en Oriente Medio que fueron evacuadas antes y durante la guerra con Irán, informó el martes The New York Times, que citó un documento interno del organismo.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El Departamento de Estado de EEUU se está preparando para enviar de regreso a sus diplomáticos a las embajadas en Oriente Medio que fueron evacuadas antes y durante la guerra con Irán, informó el martes The New York Times, que citó un documento interno del organismo. El regreso de funcionarios del Servicio Exterior y la reducción de las medidas de emergencia en las misiones estadounidenses de la región podrían comenzar esta misma semana, según el periódico. Reuters no pudo verificar de inmediato la información. No fue posible contactar de inmediato con el Departamento de Estado estadounidense fuera del horario laboral habitual para solicitar comentarios. Según el artículo, entre las embajadas que tenían previsto recuperar niveles más altos de personal figuraban las de Israel, Líbano, Arabia Saudita, Qatar, Jordania, Omán, Irak y Kuwait. En un comunicado citado por The New York Times, el Departamento de Estado dijo que "revisa continuamente las condiciones de seguridad de nuestras misiones diplomáticas en todo el mundo". "Sobre la base de nuestra evaluación más reciente, estamos ajustando la dotación de personal en determinadas misiones de Oriente Medio para garantizar que podamos seguir promoviendo los objetivos de la política exterior estadounidense y, al mismo tiempo, proteger la seguridad de nuestro personal", añadió. Según el documento, los primeros diplomáticos en regresar serían destinados a la embajada de Estados Unidos en Líbano, aunque su dotación seguiría por debajo del nivel máximo. Finalmente, el personal regresaría por completo a las embajadas estadounidenses en Israel, Jordania y Omán, de acuerdo con el informe. Las misiones en Emiratos Árabes Unidos, Arabia Saudita, Qatar y Líbano tendrían inicialmente una dotación máxima del 85%, mientras que las de Irak, Kuwait y Baréin quedarían limitadas al 75%, según el documento. Las reducciones de personal comenzaron en febrero, cuando Washington autorizó la salida voluntaria de Israel del personal no esencial y de sus familiares en medio de las tensiones con Irán.

item.title: Silveira diz ter certeza que Vale olhará grandes projetos no Brasil, inclusive de terras raras
item.description: O ministro de Minas e Energia, Alexandre Silveira, afirmou ter "absoluta certeza" de que a Vale , como uma grande referência global no setor de mineração, olhará para a necessidade de realizar grandes projetos no Brasil além do minério de ferro, em minerais críticos e estratégicos, em especial em terras raras.
item.dc:creator: Marta Nogueira
item.content:encoded: O ministro de Minas e Energia, Alexandre Silveira, afirmou ter "absoluta certeza" de que a Vale (VALE3.SA) , como uma grande referência global no setor de mineração, olhará para a necessidade de realizar grandes projetos no Brasil além do minério de ferro, em minerais críticos e estratégicos, em especial em terras raras. A afirmação, feita a jornalistas após participar da abertura do congresso de mineração Exposibram, na noite de segunda-feira, ocorreu ao ser questionado sobre o que achou da declaração do presidente da mineradora, Gustavo Pimenta, na semana passada, de que o país precisa voltar a [USN:L6N44F0ZE TEXT:"desenvolver mega projetos"]. Na ocasião, Pimenta defendia reformas no setor que ajudem a "destravar" investimentos, como as relacionadas a licenciamento ambiental, mapeamento geológico e fortalecimento da regulação do setor, e citou que o último mega projeto desenvolvido pela mineradora foi a importante mina de ferro S11D, em Canaã do Carajás (PA), que entrou em operação há 10 anos. Atualmente, o minério de ferro segue como o principal produto da Vale, mas a companhia também tem importantes projetos em níquel e cobre. "Eu acho que está perfeito, o Brasil é o paraíso dos minerais de uma forma geral, em especial agora na era da transição energética", disse Silveira na Exposibram, organizada pelo Instituto Brasileiro de Mineração (Ibram). "O Brasil, com as terras raras, vai ser uma oportunidade de reindustrializar o país, de fortalecer o emprego, a renda, a inclusão, e a Vale, como uma grande referência global do setor mineral, é uma empresa que tenho absoluta certeza que, no seu plano estratégico, vai olhar para a necessidade de grandes projetos também, além do minério de ferro, para a área dos minerais críticos e estratégicos, em especial das terras raras." Antes, em seu discurso na abertura do evento, Silveira fez acenos positivos à Vale, diferente de outras vezes, em anos passados, que criticou duramente a companhia, quando estava sob a gestão anterior. Em seu discurso, Silveira disse que teve a "alegria de ter o Gustavo à frente da Vale, com mais sensibilidade, com mais abertura" para negociar e fechar em 2024 o acordo de repactuação para reparações e compensações pelo rompimento da barragem da Samarco, joint venture da Vale com a BHP. Também disse ter ficado impressionado com as potencialidades do Pará no campo mineral, ao visitar a planta da Vale no Estado, sem dar uma data. Ele disse ter compreendido mais, na ocasião, sobre a necessidade da publicação de um decreto que defina regras ambientais mais claras sobre a proteção de cavidades naturais subterrâneas, de forma a reduzir margens de interpretação. Mineradoras, como a Vale, acreditam que a medida poderá trazer mais celeridade para licenciamentos ambientais. A jornalistas, ele disse que tal decreto sobre cavidades está atualmente na Casa Civil, "nos detalhes jurídicos, técnicos, mas está consensuado entre ministérios de Minas e Energia e Meio Ambiente". Ele evitou dar um prazo para publicação, uma vez que não depende de sua pasta. Silveira também visitou o estande da Vale na Exposibram e posou para fotos ao lado de Pimenta.

item.title: La situación de los derechos humanos en Myanmar alcanza un nuevo mínimo, según la ONU
item.description: La situación de los derechos humanos en Myanmar ha alcanzado un nuevo mínimo, con abusos generalizados contra la minoría rohinyá y una economía ilícita en auge —impulsada en parte por la extracción ilegal de tierras raras— que agrava el sufrimiento de la población civil, informó el martes la ONU.
item.dc:creator: Olivia Le Poidevin
item.content:encoded: La situación de los derechos humanos en Myanmar ha alcanzado un nuevo mínimo, con abusos generalizados contra la minoría rohinyá y una economía ilícita en auge —impulsada en parte por la extracción ilegal de tierras raras— que agrava el sufrimiento de la población civil, informó el martes la ONU. El informe de la Oficina de Derechos Humanos de la ONU, que abarca el periodo comprendido entre junio de 2025 y mayo de 2026, señala que el conflicto incesante, la violencia militar y una creciente "economía de conflicto" están exponiendo a la población civil a graves penurias. Tanto el ejército de Myanmar como el Ejército de Arakan, que controla gran parte del estado de Rakáin, han cometido violaciones generalizadas y sistemáticas contra las comunidades rohinyá, entre las que se incluyen asesinatos, torturas, reclutamiento forzoso, trabajos forzados, detenciones arbitrarias y desplazamientos. Ninguna de las partes respondió a la solicitud de comentarios de Reuters. Nueve años después del éxodo de 2017 que obligó a cientos de miles de rohinyás a huir, y tras nuevos abusos desde el golpe de Estado de 2021 que derrocó a Aung San Suu Kyi, la comunidad sigue siendo objeto de una discriminación sistemática, según la ONU. El ejército orquestó unas elecciones a principios de este año que permitieron al jefe de la junta, Min Aung Hlaing, convertirse en presidente. El ejército ha seguido recurriendo a ataques aéreos, incendios provocados y restricciones a la ayuda humanitaria para infundir miedo y mantener el control más de cinco años después del golpe de Estado, matando al menos a 8.075 civiles desde 2021, entre ellos 1.774 mujeres y 1.074 niños —una cifra que, según la ONU, probablemente sea mucho mayor—. El ejército de Myanmar ha afirmado anteriormente que llevó a cabo ataques aéreos limitados contra objetivos militares en respuesta a la toma violenta de ciudades y pueblos por parte de insurgentes y de lo que describe como grupos terroristas. El número de desplazados internos ha ascendido a 3,6 millones de personas, según la ONU, mientras que 12,4 millones se enfrentan a una situación de hambre aguda y unas 400.000 madres y niños sufren desnutrición aguda. En el norte de Rakáin, la ONU acusó al Ejército de Arakan de detenciones arbitrarias, tortura, violencia sexual, trabajos forzados y confiscaciones de tierras dirigidas contra los rohinyá, lo que incluye impedir el regreso de los rohinyás desplazados mientras se reasienta a personas no rohinyá en sus tierras. Imágenes de satélite mostraron que se habían confiscado unas 810 hectáreas. Además, varios testigos describieron cómo se utilizaba a niños de tan solo seis años para realizar trabajos forzados, y antiguos detenidos denunciaron torturas y muertes bajo custodia. El informe también destacó la rápida expansión de la minería ilegal de tierras raras en los estados de Kachin y Shan, donde el colapso del Estado de derecho ha alimentado industrias ilícitas que financian el conflicto. Las imágenes de satélite mostraron 302 nuevas explotaciones mineras en Kachin desde 2021, y un aumento en el estado de Shan, pasando de 12 explotaciones antes del golpe de Estado a 85 después. La ONU señaló que los flujos comerciales de tierras raras alcanzaron un máximo estimado de 1.400 millones de dólares en 2023, abasteciendo en gran medida al mercado chino. Las escorrentías tóxicas han contaminado cursos de agua y tierras de cultivo, lo que ha contribuido a abortos espontáneos y enfermedades crónicas a nivel local; además, la contaminación ha llegado a ríos que desembocan en Tailandia, donde los análisis revelaron niveles elevados de arsénico, plomo, mercurio y manganeso, según indicó.

item.title: US military transport plane lands in Moscow, Kremlin says it has no information yet
item.description: A U.S. military transport plane landed at Moscow's Vnukovo airport on Tuesday, data from the flight tracking service Flightradar24 showed.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A U.S. military transport plane landed at Moscow's Vnukovo airport on Tuesday, data from the flight tracking service Flightradar24 showed. The large Boeing Globemaster with the U.S. registered tail number 07-7181 had flown direct from Riga, in Latvia, and landed in Moscow at around 0700 GMT. Reuters was unable to verify whether it carried any cargo or passengers. The Kremlin said it had no information on the plane. The aircraft had arrived in Riga on August 23 from the U.S. Camp Springs airbase near Washington DC, data from Flightradar24 showed. The last direct [USN:S8N3XM05A TEXT:"flight"] of a U.S. registered jet to Russia from Europe took place in January this year, carrying special envoys Steven Witkoff and Jared Kushner for peace talks with Vladimir Putin on Ukraine. The Kremlin said last week that there was [USN:S8N4400AQ TEXT:"no information yet"] on another visit to Moscow by Kushner and Witkoff, as talks between the U.S. and Russia on Ukraine have largely stalled amid the war in Iran.

item.dc:creator: Reinhard Becker, Rene Wagner, Klaus Lauer
item.content:encoded: Die Stimmung in den Chefetagen der deutschen Unternehmen ist so gut wie seit einem Jahr nicht mehr und lässt Hoffnung auf einen tragfähigen Aufschwung aufkommen. Der Geschäftsklimaindex stieg im August das vierte Mal in Folge, wie das Münchner Ifo-Institut am Dienstag zu seiner Umfrage unter rund 9000 Führungskräften mitteilte. Das viel beachtete Konjunkturbarometer legte um satte 2,1 Zähler auf 88,8 Punkte zu. Von der Nachrichtenagentur Reuters befragte Experten hatten nur mit 87,2 Punkten gerechnet. Der Index liegt nun zudem wieder über dem Niveau, das vor dem Ende Februar ausgebrochenen Iran-Krieg erreicht wurde. "Trotz des erneuten Energiepreisanstiegs erholt sich die deutsche Wirtschaft", resümierte Ifo-Chef Clemens Fuest. "Die Beurteilung der aktuellen Lage fällt so positiv aus wie zuletzt Anfang 2024. Auch die Geschäftserwartungen haben weiter angezogen. Das sind ermutigende Signale für das laufende dritte Quartal", erläuterte Marc Schattenberg, Volkswirt bei Deutsche Bank Research. Bereits die Wachstumszahlen für das erste und zweite Quartal waren relativ stark ausgefallen. Das [USN:L8N44M08N TEXT:"Bruttoinlandsprodukt"] (BIP) stieg von April bis Juni dank höherer Exporte um 0,3 Prozent zum Vorquartal. In einer ersten Schätzung war nur von 0,2 Prozent die Rede. Und zu Jahresbeginn lag das Plus sogar bei 0,4 Prozent. Damit stehen jetzt auch die Aussichten laut Ökonomen gut, dass dieses Jahr beim Wachstum eine Eins vor dem Komma stehen könnte. Voriges Jahr hatte es nur zu einem mageren Plus von 0,2 Prozent gereicht. Die Volkswirte der deutschen Förderbank KfW und auch das gewerkschaftsnahe Institut IMK trauen der hiesigen Wirtschaft dieses Jahr nunmehr ein Plus beim BIP von 1,1 Prozent zu. Mit einem solchen Wachstum stehe Deutschland in etwa im Mittelfeld der Euro-Länder, lautet die Einschätzung des wissenschaftlichen Direktors des IMK, Sebastian Dullien. "Die deutsche Wirtschaft hat den Weg zu mehr Wachstum eingeschlagen", sagte Ifo-Experte Klaus Wohlrabe im [USN:L8N44M0BZ TEXT:"Reuters-Interview"]. Im laufenden Quartal könne es zu einem Plus von etwa 0,2 oder 0,3 Prozent reichen: "Von Bremsspuren durch das Niedrigwasser am Rhein ist in der Industrie noch nichts zu sehen." Die Chancen für einen anhaltenden [USN:L8N44M0HD TEXT:"Exportaufschwung"] stehen gut: "Digitalisierung und KI-Boom helfen der deutschen Wirtschaft", erklärte Wohlrabe. Für den Bau von Rechenzentren für die boomende Künstliche Intelligenz ist in vielen Bereichen deutsche Technik gefragt. Auch die Exporterwartungen der deutschen Industriebetriebe haben sich im August aufgehellt. "WIRTSCHAFT DIVERSIFIZIERT SICH" "Die deutsche Industrie befindet sich also aller Unkenrufe zum Trotz im Aufschwung", erläuterte der Chefvolkswirt der Liechtensteiner VP Bank, Thomas Gitzel. Zwar leide der Automobilsektor, doch in anderen Branchen sei man sehr zuversichtlich. Dies betreffe etwa den Maschinenbau oder auch die Medizintechnik: "Die deutsche Wirtschaft vollzieht derzeit einen Strukturwandel und dürfte – um es positiv zu formulieren – ihre starke Abhängigkeit vom Automobilsektor reduzieren. Die deutsche Wirtschaft diversifiziert sich derzeit." Auch im Bauhauptgewerbe ist die Stimmung laut Ifo gestiegen. Dies war auf merklich weniger pessimistische Erwartungen zurückzuführen. Die Urteile zur aktuellen Lage wurden hingegen leicht nach unten korrigiert. Dazu passt, dass der Verband der Bauindustrie seine Umsatzprognose für 2026 gesenkt hat. Es werde real - also inflationsbereinigt - nur noch ein Zuwachs von einem Prozent statt bisher 2,5 Prozent erwartet, teilte der Verband in Berlin mit. "Angesichts der bis einschließlich Mai stark gebremsten Baukonjunktur und den steigenden Baukosten ist unsere ursprüngliche Prognose nicht mehr zu halten." Vor allem der Wohnungsbau laufe nicht rund. Hier werde nur noch ein Plus von 0,5 Prozent erwartet statt bisher zwei Prozent. Ein starker Juni habe Schlimmeres verhindert. Im Juni verbuchten die Unternehmen mit 20 oder mehr Beschäftigten dank einiger Großaufträge spürbar mehr Bestellungen, wie das Statistische Bundesamt mitteilte. Die Aufträge kletterten real zum Vormonat saison- und kalenderbereinigt um sechs Prozent und zum Vorjahresmonat gab es inflationsbereinigt ein Plus von 11,3 Prozent. "Der Juni war ein guter Monat für die Bauwirtschaft", sagte Hauptgeschäftsführer Felix Pakleppa vom Branchenverband ZDB. Erfreulich sei vor allem der kräftige Anstieg im Straßenbau und im öffentlichen Bau. "Aber nach einem schwankenden ersten Halbjahr wäre es verfrüht, jetzt schon von einer Bauwende zu sprechen." Ein kräftiges Plus hätten die Betriebe in ihren Auftragsbüchern bisher nicht.

item.title: Ucrania ve opción de mediación de EEUU para acabar la guerra antes del verano de 2027
item.description: Ucrania ve una oportunidad para que la mediación de Estados Unidos ponga fin a la guerra de Rusia en Ucrania antes de que termine el próximo verano boreal y ha elaborado un documento de una página con ideas, en colaboración con dirigentes estadounidenses y europeos, para presentarlo a Moscú, ha declarado el presidente Volodímir Zelenski.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Ucrania ve una oportunidad para que la mediación de Estados Unidos ponga fin a la guerra de Rusia en Ucrania antes de que termine el próximo verano boreal y ha elaborado un documento de una página con ideas, en colaboración con dirigentes estadounidenses y europeos, para presentarlo a Moscú, ha declarado el presidente Volodímir Zelenski. Zelenski señaló que entre las ideas recogidas en el documento se encontraban un alto el fuego y una propuesta estadounidense ya debatida anteriormente para crear una zona económica libre en la región oriental del Dombás, en Ucrania, que sería administrada por una tercera parte. "Contiene una de las ideas para un alto el fuego; ese es el punto principal. La segunda parte se refiere a lo que propusieron los estadounidenses en relación con una zona económica libre", dijo Zelenski a los periodistas en una rueda de prensa celebrada este fin de semana. Zelenski señaló que veía una oportunidad para poner fin a los casi cuatro años y medio de combates, que se extenderían desde la cumbre del G20 celebrada en Estados Unidos en diciembre de este año hasta finales del verano boreal de 2027, dada la inminente campaña para las elecciones presidenciales de 2028 en Estados Unidos. Zelenski había declarado a principios de este mes que Ucrania había entregado a los negociadores estadounidenses propuestas para un plan destinado a poner fin a la guerra, sin ofrecer más detalles. Las conversaciones de paz lideradas por Estados Unidos se rompieron a principios de este año, ya que Ucrania rechazó las exigencias rusas de ceder más territorio y Washington se vio cada vez más absorto en el conflicto con Irán. Los negociadores estadounidenses Steve Witkoff y Jared Kushner estuvieron por última vez en Moscú en enero y aún no han visitado Kiev. Zelenski señaló que el tercer elemento del borrador de la propuesta era el papel que desempeñarían la Unión Europea y la OTAN, y lo que "Ucrania está dispuesta a hacer para lograrlo". No dio más detalles al respecto. "Estas tres ideas que he mencionado no son exclusivamente ucranianas", afirmó Zelenski, y añadió que se habían elaborado conjuntamente con los estadounidenses y los europeos, y que algunas de ellas procedían de conversaciones previas que los negociadores estadounidenses habían mantenido con Ucrania y Rusia. Rusia se mostraba dispuesta a escuchar nuevas propuestas sobre cómo alcanzar un acuerdo en el conflicto de Ucrania, pero estas debían reflejar las "realidades sobre el terreno", dijo un alto diplomático ruso en una entrevista publicada la semana pasada. El objetivo principal de Moscú es hacerse con el resto del Dombás, donde ha estado realizando una ofensiva para avanzar hacia el denominado "cinturón de fortalezas" de las ciudades del este de Ucrania.

item.title: ICC sees a Himalayan fairytale in Nepal's remarkable rise
item.description: For years, Nepal has been one of cricket's great stories-in-waiting: a country of extraordinary public passion, flashes of on-field promise and crowds that treat every international as a national event.
item.dc:creator: Amlan Chakraborty
item.content:encoded: For years, Nepal has been one of cricket's great stories-in-waiting: a country of extraordinary public passion, flashes of on-field promise and crowds that treat every international as a national event. Now even the game's global governing body believes the Himalayan nation of 30 million could be the next Associate member of the International Cricket Council to take their place at the sport's top table. "They could be tomorrow's Afghanistan, or tomorrow's New Zealand for that matter," ICC Chief Executive Sanjog Gupta told Reuters. "They have developed an elite player pool which is consistently breaking through the ICC pathways and not only featuring at our marquee events, but proving that they belong on the global stage." The Afghanistan comparison is hard to escape. From its Associate beginnings, a war-torn Afghanistan fell in love with cricket, impressed in shorter formats and eventually earned test status in 2017. Like Afghanistan, Nepal may not bring the game huge riches but will be a welcome expansion of the sport, which remains popular in certain pockets and is played by a dozen teams at the elite level. "Nepal represents enormous potential and opportunity for cricket," explained Gupta. "Not because the country is a significant commercial market, but because of their rapidly improving standards of performance and the scale of fandom the sport enjoys in the country." PASSIONATE FAN BASE The ICC has pumped nearly $5 million into Nepal's cricket development in the last two years and has awarded the country co-hosting rights for next year's under-19 Women's World Cup. "Nepal benefits from the biggest endowment any sport can wish for - a large, deeply passionate fan base," said Gupta, adding, "Fans today are also the players of tomorrow". "One of my personal highlights from the Twenty20 World Cup 2026 was the sea of red at the Wankhede (Stadium), which had turned up to support Nepal against Scotland." Nepal beat Scotland by seven wickets to claim their first victory on that world stage since 2014, although both teams had already been eliminated. Qualifying for the T20 World Cup for the first time in 2014 was the turning point for Nepal. In a region dominated by cricketing heavyweights India, Pakistan and Sri Lanka, Nepal had long watched others and suddenly it had a team of its own. One-day international status in 2018 helped cricket overtake football as the country's favourite sport. "It really skyrocketed this sport into Nepali households," former captain and secretary of the Cricket Association of Nepal Paras Khadka told Reuters. "Qualification meant people started to have faith in the team. All of a sudden, it brought out national sentiments, and a sense of pride in Nepalis." 'FESTIVAL OF HIMALAYAS' Two seasons of the Nepal Premier League have added significant revenue to sustain the game's growth. "If we are to grow as a cricketing nation, the NPL will be a pivotal part of the growth," Khadka said of the T20 league, underlining the commercial and entertainment value of the 'Festival of Himalayas'. "Whatever money NPL generated has been used in cricket itself. It's a strong commercial avenue for us now. "If this keeps growing, we'll create that cushion for us to start development programmes and build infrastructure, which requires a lot of financial stability." The country's cricket fervour rivals that of India, but Khadka, who captained Nepal for over a decade before stepping down in 2019, says sustained performance remains non-negotiable. "You could have everything around you, but if you don't play good cricket, people don't follow you," he said. Nepal showed it can compete in the 20-overs format, nearly pulling off upsets against England and South Africa at the World Cup in India earlier this year. "You only become a better cricketer when you play against better cricketers, and you become a better team when you play against better teams," said Khadka. That need for exposure anchors Nepal's next phase, with the board planning bilateral cricket against test-playing nations. "We are in conversations, and hopefully this gets materialised very soon," Khadka said. Nepal has also rolled out player contracts for men and women, introduced red-ball cricket and is expanding infrastructure. For Khadka, Afghanistan's rise is a model worth emulating. "There's a blueprint for sure," he said. "We definitely would like to follow the same journey."

item.title: Futures in rialzo su recupero tech, occhi su Nvidia, inflazione
item.description: I futures sugli indici azionari statunitensi sono in rialzo, con i titoli tecnologici recuperano dalle pesanti perdite della seduta precedente, mentre gli investitori attendono dati cruciali sull'inflazione e i risultati di Nvidia.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: I futures sugli indici azionari statunitensi sono in rialzo, con i titoli tecnologici recuperano dalle pesanti perdite della seduta precedente, mentre gli investitori attendono dati cruciali sull'inflazione e i risultati di Nvidia. ** Nel pre-market, la maggior parte dei titoli a grande capitalizzazione guadagna terreno. NVIDIA (NVDA.O) sale dell'1,3% e META (META.O) dell'1,06%. ** Il produttore di chip di memoria MICRON (MU.O) guadagna il 3,05%, mentre WESTERN DIGITAL (WDC.O) e SANDISK (SNDK.O) salgono rispettivamente del 3,48% e del 4,4%. ** I mercati sono in gran parte scettici sulla minaccia degli Stati Uniti di escludere dal sistema finanziario basato sul dollaro i Paesi che continueranno a commerciare con l’Iran. Washington non ha indicato né i Paesi coinvolti né le tempistiche di entrata in vigore delle sanzioni. ** Alle 12.15, i Dow E-mini avanzano dello 0,49%, gli S&P 500 E-mini dello 0,52% e i Nasdaq 100 E-mini dello 0,98%. ** Gli investitori guardano a una serie di appuntamenti chiave: la pubblicazione dei risultati trimestrali di Nvidia, attesa per domani dopo la chiusura dei mercati, e i dati Pce sulle spese per consumi personali, in uscita prima dell'apertura delle contrattazioni. ** Il colosso dei chip per l'intelligenza artificiale è chiamato a confermare la solidità della domanda trainata dall'IA. Qualsiasi segnale di rallentamento potrebbe riaccendere i timori sulle valutazioni eccessive e sulla tenuta di un rally senza precedenti. ** I timori legati alla rapida crescita del debito pubblico e ai prezzi elevati del petrolio hanno spinto il rendimento dei Treasury a 30 anni ai massimi degli ultimi 19 anni la scorsa settimana, penalizzando i titoli tech e trascinando in territorio negativo i tre principali indici. ** L'intervento del Tesoro, che ha previsto un aumento dei riacquisti e, secondo alcune fonti, il ricorso alle proprie riserve di liquidità per finanziarli, sta contribuendo ad allentare in parte le tensioni. ** Nel frattempo, i dati Pce potrebbero offrire maggiore chiarezza sulle pressioni inflazionistiche nell'economia, dopo che i dati moderati sull'inflazione al consumo di questo mese hanno sostanzialmente ridimensionato le aspettative di un rialzo dei tassi da parte della Fed a settembre. ** Ciononostante, secondo i dati Lseg, gli operatori continuano a scontare un aumento di 25 punti base entro fine anno. ** In questo quadro, il discorso del presidente della Fed Kevin Warsh, in programma venerdì a Jackson Hole, sarà seguito con grande attenzione per capire come la banca centrale intenda orientare la politica monetaria alla luce dell'intervento del Tesoro e degli ultimi sviluppi economici.

item.title: Allemagne-Le PIB au T2 dépasse les estimations, signalant un nouvel élan
item.description: Le produit intérieur brut (PIB) de l'Allemagne a progressé plus que prévu au deuxième trimestre par rapport au précédent, montrent mardi les données définitives publiées par l'Office fédéral de la statistique, renforçant l'espoir d'un redressement prochain de la première économie d'Europe.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Le produit intérieur brut (PIB) de l'Allemagne a progressé plus que prévu au deuxième trimestre par rapport au précédent, montrent mardi les données définitives publiées par l'Office fédéral de la statistique, renforçant l'espoir d'un redressement prochain de la première économie d'Europe. Au deuxième trimestre, le PIB a augmenté de 0,3%, par rapport au trimestre précédent, légèrement au-dessus de la première lecture et des attentes des économistes interrogés par Reuters (+0,2%). La publication intervient après une amélioration plus marquée que prévu du [USN:ZRN00EEIX TEXT:"moral des investisseurs"] allemands la semaine dernière, des données plus solides qu'anticipé pour les [USN:ZRN00EARK TEXT:"exportations"] et la [USN:ZRN00EARF TEXT:"production industrielle"] au début du mois, ainsi que des [USN:L6N44A0HT TEXT:"résultats trimestriels"] robustes pour [USN:L6N4430HP TEXT:"les entreprises"] du pays. "L'économie allemande maintient l'élan de croissance observé au début de l'année", déclare Ruth Brand, présidente de l'Office fédéral de la statistique. La hausse des prix de l'énergie résultant de la guerre en Iran a freiné la reprise tant attendue de l'économie allemande, amenant le gouvernement a [USN:L6N4150VP TEXT:"abaisser en avril"] ses [USN:L8N40Z1I9 TEXT:"prévisions de croissance"] pour 2026 et 2027. Comme sur les trois premiers mois de l'année, la croissance a principalement été tirée par les exportations, qui progressent de 2,0% en glissement trimestriel. "Les détails publiés aujourd'hui montrent que la reprise économique notable observée depuis la fin de l'année dernière est principalement attribuable à une demande étrangère plus forte", commente Ralph Solveen, économiste chez Commerzbank. "Même si un léger coup d'arrêt se profile au troisième trimestre en raison des prix élevés de l'énergie et de la sécheresse, les chiffres d'aujourd'hui suggèrent de légers risques à la hausse pour notre prévision selon laquelle l'économie allemande croîtra de 1% cette année", ajoute-t-il. En rythme annuel, le PIB ressort en hausse de 1,0%, contre une première estimation tablant sur +0,9%, après +0,4% au premier trimestre.

Top order batter Pasindu Sooriyabandara led Sri Lanka's fight with a fine 80 but missed out on a maiden test hundred. The batter tried to defend a Ravindra Jadeja delivery with an angled bat and dragged the ball onto his stumps. item.title: Morning Bid: Economic salvos
item.description: What matters in U.S. and global markets today
item.dc:creator: Mike Dolan
item.content:encoded: What matters in U.S. and global markets today By Mike Dolan , Editor-At-Large, Finance and Markets World markets slipped into a holding pattern on Tuesday as investors tried to make sense of the noisy U.S. economic warfare that has dominated the start of the week ahead of the big macro events in the coming days. [USN:L1N44L0ES TEXT:""Economic D-Day" in Iran underwhelmed,"] while Donald Trump's administration threatened even more levies on Canadian goods. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent’s plan to squeeze Iran’s economy via sanctions on countries and entities financing Tehran was [USN:L6N44M029 TEXT:"shorter on detail than many had expected"] and essentially amounted to a warning shot to those still engaged with the country. The timeline for action also seems uncertain, but Iran said it would not be cowed and would retaliate against any measures. Meantime, U.S.-Canada trade tensions ratcheted up further after 50% tariffs on $20 billion worth of Canadian goods came into effect. President Trump responded to Canadian retaliation with a [USN:L8N44L114 TEXT:"threat to slap 50% levies"] on Canadian-made cars, trucks and automotive parts. Both sets of headlines had little impact on markets, although Canada’s dollar did slip and Wall Street did end lower on Monday. A softer oil price kept a lid on Treasury yields. Speaking of the bond market, Secretary Bessent's recent announcement of increased bond-buying got another negative review, this time from billionaire investor Stanley Druckenmiller, a former colleague of Bessent's at Soros Fund Management. In a Wall Street Journal opinion piece, Druckenmiller said debt management calculated to cosset the bond market around the midterm elections "spends the one asset that took two centuries to accumulate: the [USN:L6N44K07X TEXT:"credibility of the Treasury market."]" Back to equities, the U.S. stock retreat was led by weakness in tech, ahead of [USN:L6N44I0TK TEXT:"Nvidia’s results tomorrow. "]Tech ructions were felt in Asia as well, after a $[USN:P8N43T02S TEXT:"10 billion share sale by China’s Alibaba"] to fund its AI plans knocked its stock down by 10%. Recent spectacular IPOs in China also backtracked, with robot maker Unitree’s shares [USN:L4N44K01K TEXT:"losing almost half of the 600% rise"] clocked on its first day of trading earlier this month. Wednesday is the first big macro day of the week, with Nvidia’s update preceded by U.S. PCE data for July. Today, investors get the August U.S. Consumer Confidence survey from the Conference Board, and 2-year Treasury notes come under the hammer. Chart of the day China, which may find itself in the cross-hairs of U.S. sanctions on countries still trading with Iran, has become a key swing player in global oil markets as it has been critical to how oil prices have reacted to the Iran conflict. The drop in Chinese demand for crude imports over the past six months, reflecting a pullback in refining and exports of refined products, has been a significant factor in offsetting the supply crunch from the Gulf.
